_comment: Anticholinergic Cognitive Burden (ACB) scale and Sedative Burden Index — scores 0-3. Clinically curated from Boustani ACB Scale (2008, 2012), Carnahan ADS, Rudolph ARS, German PRISCUS list (2023), Beers Criteria (AGS 2023), and NHS Guidelines.

_scoring.0: No clinically relevant anticholinergic or sedative burden
_scoring.1: Mild burden — possible anticholinergic or sedative activity
_scoring.2: Moderate burden — definite anticholinergic or sedative activity
_scoring.3: Severe burden — strongly anticholinergic/sedative, high risk in elderly and polypharmacy
